source: User request 2026-10-14: move the play camera with touchscreen, controller or mouse. See src/view/wt_camera_controls.gd.

turn_notes.duration_ms: length of one 30 degree snap turn in ms
turn_notes.overshoot: ease-out-back s constant; 0.8 overshoots about 2.3 percent of the turn (0.7 deg of 30) then settles
turn_notes.reduced_duration_ms: turn length under reduced motion; 0 = instant cut, otherwise linear with no overshoot
turn_notes.parallax_ratio: backdrop (sky + far islands) drifts this fraction of the camera yaw rate, then eases back; 0 = glued
turn_notes.parallax_settle_per_s: exponential rate the drifted backdrop returns to rest once the camera stops
turn_notes.sky_shift_per_deg: sky shader shift (aspect-scaled screen widths) per degree of drift
turn_notes.max_drift_deg: cap on backdrop drift in degrees
